name: Hask
title: Outfitter
examine: Fifteen High Road winters are written on his face, mostly around the scar. He is looking at your boots and finding them wanting.
lines: Show me your boots. Mm. You'll want better before the Fork.
Fifteen years walking Waykeeper escort. I trained half the watch on this wall, and Captain Aldis trained me right back.
It isn't the road that kills you. It's setting out short of what you need.
